Raleigh holds regular elections in even years since S.L. 2021-56 section 1.8, with mayoral terms of two years. The state results files for the October and November election dates of this year contain no Raleigh mayor contest.

S.L. 2021-56 section 1.8 sets two-year terms and regular elections in even years from 2022. The 2026 regular election falls on the November 3, 2026 general election date listed by Wake County, after the September 14, 2026 cutoff. No earlier mayoral round is scheduled in this plurality system (2022 and 2024 had none). No mayoral election in the window.
